name: ode23
covers: ode23(f, tspan, y0)            scalar IVP, explicit tspan
ode23(f, tspan, y0, opts)      with odeset() opts
cubic Hermite dense-output at explicit tspan points
comment: Sig 1+2: ode23(@f, tspan, y0) and ode23(@f, tspan, y0, opts). MATLAB R2025b runs the Bogacki-Shampine 3(2) embedded pair with FSAL k4 and cubic Hermite dense output between accepted steps; numkit ode23 implements the same Butcher tableau (Bogacki-Shampine 1989, Appl.Math.Lett. 2:321-325) and the same interpolant (Shampine-Reichelt 1997). With explicit tspan + tight tols, numkit and MATLAB land identically on the requested sample points (verified ~1e-9). Refine default = 1 (matching MATLAB ode23, NOT 4 like ode45). MaxStep, multi-variable, reverse integration covered by gtest + smoke.
